description: Process multiple files in one request. Returns per-file extraction results plus aggregate counts.

file_paths.description: List of absolute file paths to extract.

name: batch_extract

description: Identify the file format using magic-bytes detection. Returns the format name and a confidence score in [0, 1].

file_path.description: Absolute path to the file to inspect.

name: detect_format_tool

description: Extract content from a single document file. Supports DOCX, PPTX, PDF, XLSX, CSV, JSON, XML, HTML, EPUB, EML, MSG, and images. Returns markdown and/or XLIFF depending on output_formats.

auth_token.description: Shared secret for MCP auth (when MCP_SHARED_SECRET is set).

file_path.description: Absolute path to the source document.

ocr_lang.description: OCR language code (e.g. 'chi_sim', 'jpn', 'fra'). Sets OPP_OCR_LANG env var before extraction. Default: 'eng'.

traceparent.description: Optional W3C Trace Context traceparent header to make this span a child of an upstream trace.

verbose.description: Include extra metadata (detected_format, confidence, processing_steps) in the response.

name: extract_document

description: Convert a document to Markdown format.

style_mapping.description: Optional mapping from style name to heading level.

name: generate_markdown

description: Convert a document to XLIFF format for translation workflows. Requires source and target language codes.
name: generate_xliff

description: Return OPP module capabilities: supported input formats (16), output formats (md/xliff), and the list of available MCP tools. Use this to discover what the server can do at runtime.
name: get_capabilities

description: Save skeleton ZIP from an extracted DOCX/PPTX. The skeleton is required by ORF's apply_xliff for XLIFF->DOCX/PPTX backfill.
name: save_skeleton

description: Validate an XLIFF 1.2 file against the OASIS XSD schema and the trans-unit content rules (non-empty source, unique IDs, valid lang codes). Pass either xliff_content (inline string) or file_path.

file_path.description: Path to .xlf/.xliff file. Used only if xliff_content is not provided.

xliff_content.description: Inline XLIFF XML. Takes precedence over file_path if both provided.

name: validate_xliff
